in_hebrew.name: Hoyt
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו From the Old English 'heah-thu', meaning 'high-minded'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hoyt הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The Old English name 'Hoyt' is derived from the Old English words 'heah' meaning 'high' and 'thu' meaning 'mind' or 'thought'. This name can be interpreted as 'high-minded' or 'lofty in thought'. In Christian tradition, the name Hoyt can also symbolize the spiritual ascent towards God, as one strives to live a virtuous and righteous life.
